name: OmaAgents
author: SherryMaster
description: AI coding agent usage for the Omarchy bar: Claude Code, Codex and Fireworks limits with pace, today's tokens and API-equivalent cost at a glance, and a details report with models, sessions, cache and cost mix for any period, plus CPAMC account pools: pooled limits, per-account windows and kicks.

barWidget.description: Limits and today's tokens and cost at a glance; models, sessions, mix and any period in Details.

schema.label: Glance period
schema.description: The period whose tokens and cost the first screen shows. Cycle falls back to Today without a renewal date.

schema.label: Show account email
schema.description: Turn off to keep the email out of screen shares.

schema.label: "In use" window (minutes)
schema.description: A pooled account reads as in use while it served tokens within this many minutes; otherwise it reads as idle.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.
